{"title": "Wire the serial console with a shared ground first", "confidence": "explicit", "tags": ["hardware", "serial"], "evidence": [{"source": "fixture", "locator": "synthetic:serial-console-wiring.md", "note": "Synthetic evidence for recall tests"}], "priority": 3}

Connect ground before the data lines and keep the adapter at 3.3 volts. Do not feed the board from the adapter unless the label allows it; the supply power comes from the wall.
